claims.label: Accelerated / Future Rent
claims.note: Discounted to present value using a 5%-9% annual rate range (industry/court practice, not a flat percentage haircut). Net of actual/anticipated replacement-tenant rent.

claims.label: Wrongful Eviction / Unlawful Lockout
claims.note: No damages amount entered -- probability shown reflects state self-help law and whether statutory process was followed.

claims.label: Attorney's Fees
claims.note: Posture-tiered flat-dollar estimate (went to trial) -- fees are driven by procedural effort, not claim size, for a typical matter in this range; a large or unusually complex matter can run higher.

extractedFacts.wrongfulLockoutCitation: Tex. Prop. Code Sec. 93.002/93.003 -- actual damages + greater of one month's rent or $500, plus reasonable attorney's fees and costs.

outcome.description: After a bench trial the court awarded the landlord $170,484.37 in past-due rent, the full amount it sought, with no credit for the $62,096.52 free-rent overlap offset or the $20,000 personal property. It also awarded $86,725.00 in attorney's fees. On appeal the rent damages were affirmed and the fee award reversed.
outcome.finalNote: Rent damages affirmed; fee award reversed.
